name: geometry-tactical-classroom-v60
description: Offline classroom Windows installer with improved Thales labels, a 30-minute mission, three controlled 30-second pauses, full-name login, eighth-grade group selection, finite weapon throws, melee combat, procedural right-triangle questions, and encrypted PIN-protected local results.

scripts.test: npm run prepare && node --check school-game/v60/main.js && node --check school-game/v60/preload.js && node --check school-game/v60/game.js && node scripts/classroom-v60-static-test.js
scripts.dist:win: npm run prepare && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dir:win: npm run prepare && electron-builder --win dir --x64 --publish never
